MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Overgrazing continuously

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conservation of marine and freshwater environments? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ornamental Fish culture? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ornamental Fish culture.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Ornamental Fish culture.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ornamental Fish culture.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ornamental Fish culture.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Ecology and Ecosystems? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.

5. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.

7. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Nitrogen gas only

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Reproduction? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Reproduction.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Reproduction.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Reproduction.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Reproduction.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.

10. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

11. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

12. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Safety of Humans and Equipment in Marine Activities 4.2 Marine Operations and Se and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Maritime Operations and Seamanship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Marine Operations and Seamanship 4.3 Marine Resource Utilisation 4.4 Blue Econom and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Safety of Humans and Equipment Undertaking Marine Activities and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

1. B — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

2. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.

3. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ornamental Fish culture.

4. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.

5. D — Ice melting to water

6. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.

7. B — Glucose and oxygen

8. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Reproduction.

9. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.

10. B — 100 °C

11. B — Producers

12. D — Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
